task.target: largest connected component among semantic foreground labels 1-20 in each image
task.clean_prompt: tight target bounding box plus target interior distance-transform maximum
task.training_policy: no learning or tuning on confirmatory validation data

splits.exploratory: The previously committed 30 validation rows remain exploratory only.

confirmatory.sampling: all validation rows; no subsampling or minimum-area exclusion

metrics.aggregation: macro average over target instances with paired sample-level deltas

primary_hypotheses.comparison: robust_superpixel versus center_color under clean prompts
SAM score-selected ensemble versus a single noisy prompt under calibrated moderate point+box noise
primary_hypotheses.direction: score selection has higher mean IoU

primary_hypotheses.comparison: SAM box-noise loss versus point-noise loss at matched calibrated prompt quality
primary_hypotheses.direction: box noise causes a larger mean IoU loss

statistics.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap 95% interval over sample-level deltas
statistics.secondary_analyses: exploratory; report effect sizes and intervals without confirmatory language
statistics.oracle_policy: oracle selections are descriptive upper bounds and excluded from deployable claims

noise_calibration.box_quality: mean IoU with the clean tight box
noise_calibration.selection: independent deterministic grid search minimizing absolute error to the same quality target

frozen_source_hash_canonicalization: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization

integrity.amendment: Post-audit execution guards only; frozen hypotheses, methods, prompts, calibration, and statistical tests are unchanged.

reporting.required_failures: report missing cases, runtime failures, and exclusions; no silent dropping
reporting.anonymity: submission PDF and supplementary artifact must contain no author, repository, account, or Git-history identity
